items.title: Why United Parcel Service (UPS) Stock Is Down Today
items.summary: Shares of parcel delivery company UPS (NYSE:UPS) fell 3.7% in the morning session after the company posted second-quarter results where a steep drop in profitability overshadowed a beat on revenue and adjusted earnings. The parcel delivery company reported revenue of $22.8 billion and adjusted earnings of $1.76 per share, both surpassing Wall Street expectations.
